name: nexus
description: NEXUS — a premium multi-agent AI collaboration workspace

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @nexus/api
scripts.start: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @nexus/mobile
scripts.ios: npm run build:shared && npm run ios -w @nexus/mobile
scripts.android: npm run build:shared && npm run android -w @nexus/mobile
scripts.web: npm run build:shared && npm run web -w @nexus/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/api && npm run typecheck -w @nexus/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nexus/mobile && npm run lint -w @nexus/api
